subject.title: fix(web-fetch): extract full HTML body content

question: Should title-only Readability output keep the documented provider-before-basic-cleanup fallback order, even though this can invoke configured providers for pages that previously returned local title-only output?
rationale: The patch fixes the right runtime decision point, but fallback order affects compatibility, latency, and provider cost for existing installations, so automation should not choose that product tradeoff.

options.title: Accept provider-first fallback
options.body: Merge with the current order, preserving the documented Readability to provider to basic cleanup sequence for this newly detected title-only class.

options.title: Switch title-only local-first
options.body: Ask for title-only pages to try the already-fetched body before external provider fallback to minimize provider calls and latency.

options.title: Pause for broader policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers want a broader extraction policy change before accepting title-only fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept provider-first fallback
recommendation.body: Merge with the current order, preserving the documented Readability to provider to basic cleanup sequence for this newly detected title-only class.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest history on the web fetch provider boundary this decision affects.
